thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xxs and GPU queue growth on hosted inference cluster rwd-host-3. Cause: sudden spike in external-tool invocations and JSON-mode streaming responses. Metric: 5xx rate 7.8% (baseline 0.2%), GPU queue length +220. Paging eng-sre and oncall.
Sam: Paging in — I'm taking this one. Looking at logs now. Any recent deploys?
Marta: no deploys from infra in the last 6h. Saw a jump in agent/third-party invocation traffic ~23:10 UTC.
Priya: customer reports started around 23:05. Could be a runaway job hitting function-call endpoints.
Jae: seeing repeated /v1/agent/invoke with large JSON schemas in body. Many requests include tools[]=browser and tools[]=sql.
Sam: Risk: continuous structured outputs (JSON-mode) keep sockets open and increase token cost + GPU work. Plan: apply temporary throttles and fallback to plain text responses where possible.
Norman: do we have a quick toggle to disable agent/tool invocation at the gateway?
ops-bot: ops-run:apply --target gateway-routes --patch '{"match": "/v1/agent/invoke", "action": "rate_limit", "rps": 2, "burst": 5}' started by Sam.
Sam: Applied initial global rate limit for /v1/agent/invoke to 2 rps per token-bucket. Observe for 60s.
Marta: adding a soft quota per-account for agent calls (10/min) in parallel. Sending policy update.
Priya: also enabling a streaming-mode downgrade: if Accept: application/json-stream then respond with text/plain fallback. That will stop long-lived JSON streams.
Jae: command I ran on control plane to set fallback: 
```
POST /admin/policies/fallback
{
  "matcher": "json-stream",
  "fallback": "text-only",
  "reason": "mitigate long-lived json streams"
}
```
Sam: Noted. ops-bot, patch service mesh rule to reject tool list length >3 for hosted tier.
ops-bot: ops-run:apply --target mesh-policy --patch '{"max_tool_count":3, "enforce": true}' completed.
Marta: traffic shaping in progress. GPU queue depth trending down from +220 to +85 in last 4m. Error rate still elevated but falling.
Priya: customer-facing impact: users relying on structured outputs may see truncated or plain-text answers. We should prepare a DM/notice for affected high-usage orgs.
Sam: Agreed. Sam -> notify-sales to flag top 20 orgs with >50 agent calls/min. Drafting short note.
Jae: Quick safety: disable function/tool call attachments in the streaming proxy for public hosted tier. Config snippet applied: 
```
stream_proxy:
  allow_tool_calls: false
  allow_json_stream: false
```
Norman: Will that break enterprise/private deployments? Make sure scope is hosted-only.
Sam: Scoped to hosted; Dedicated and Private unaffected. Confirmed.
Marta: adding a gradual rollback window: keep mitigations for 30m, then reduce rate limits to 5 rps and re-evaluate.
Priya: I've posted an incident note in the incident tracking board with initial customer list and mitigation steps.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling configuration changes propagated to all rwd-host-* clusters.
Jae: monitoring: token consumption down 37%, median latency improved from 820ms -> 420ms on affected endpoints. 5xxs now 1.1%.
Sam: Good. Next: run a short canary enabling JSON-mode for a trusted tenant to validate safety path. Marta take the canary.
Marta: Starting canary for tenant: alpha-test-5. Will watch for queue increases.
Priya: Communications: draft message for status.redwood.ai: "Temporarily restricting agent/tool invocations and structured-streaming for hosted tier to stabilize service. Customers may see plain-text fallbacks. We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes."
Sam: ETA 30m for next update. Assigning follow-up: Marta will own rollback decision, Jae will own observability checks, Priya will owner comms, Norman will check enterprise scope.
Norman: thumbs up. Handing to Marta after 5m.
Marta: taking handoff. If metrics stay stable for next 10m, start relaxing limits to pre-mitigation levels in steps.
Sam: Thanks team—great coordination. Will keep this thread live until full rollback.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation actions applied: global rate-limit on /v1/agent/invoke; max_tool_count enforced; json streaming downgraded to text; hosted-only scope. All changes logged under run-id: rwd-mitigate-2016002468.
Marta: update 10m: GPU queue stable ~40, 5xx ~0.6%. Proceeding to step 1 rollback (rate limit -> 5rps).
ops-bot: ops-run:apply --target gateway-routes --patch '{"match": "/v1/agent/invoke", "action": "rate_limit", "rps": 5, "burst": 10}' completed.
Jae: Observability: token usage creeping up but latency still improved vs pre-incident. Continue to watch for regressions.
Priya: posting update to status page now.
Sam: closing note: we avoided broad feature disable for Dedicated/Private customers, limited customer impact, and regained stable queue behavior. Will schedule a postmortem to discuss rate-limit knobs and better early-detection alerts for large JSON-mode sessions.
Marta: adding follow-up action: create an automated detector for sustained JSON-stream connections >30s.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: last change at 2016002842. Follow-up: postmortem owners Sam, Marta.
